limitations: Grade assignment is a source-based working map requiring independent matrix audit; no release percentage is claimed.
Listed grade character sets are new/revisited list occurrences, not cumulative proficiency targets or a complete word vocabulary.
A writing-list character is not evidence that selecting it measures handwriting.
Higher Chinese adds depth and writing expectations; sharing an item across courses needs course-specific QA.

Future-grade-only text-type classification, main idea, implicit meaning, causal prediction, comparison, author intent, critique, information application, full description and independent revision are excluded; their source boundary is recorded in the preparation note.
Language-use leaves (量词, 词语搭配, 选词, 关联词, 排列成句, 句式转换) are an author working map under existing MOE outcome pages; they need independent page and course-depth review.
Shared CL/HCL tagging does not establish HCL-specific depth; HCL-only evidence is still required before any HCL coverage claim.

Owner decision (2026-10-16): collocation, word choice, word in context and character in context are repair targets for abilities, not individual words. Repair uses other words to practise the same ability, and progress is reported for the ability, never as a specific word repaired. A concrete word target would need its own kind=word record and matching repair pool.
